summary: This short note is a biographical stub about Stewart Patridge, born December 6, 1974, a former American football quarterback. It says he was best known as the leader of the University of Mississippi Rebels from 1995 to 1997. It also states that he won the 1997 Conerly Trophy, described as the best college football player in the state.
one_line: Stewart Patridge is a former American football quarterback who led the University of Mississippi Rebels from 1995 to 1997 and won the 1997 Conerly Trophy.
